import unittest

from solution import select_visible_profiles


class SelectVisibleProfilesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_selection_order_and_deep_copy_independence(self):
        shared = {"skills": ["python"], "address": {"city": "Bengaluru"}}
        followers = [
            {"id": "u2", "display_name": "Two", "profile": shared},
            {"id": "u1", "display_name": "One", "profile": shared},
            {"id": "u3", "display_name": "Three", "profile": {"skills": []}},
        ]
        visible = ["u1", "u2"]
        result = select_visible_profiles(followers, visible)
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result], ["u2", "u1"])
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["profile"], shared)
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["profile"], shared)

        shared["skills"].append("changed-input")
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["profile"]["skills"], ["python"])
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["profile"]["skills"], ["python"])

        result[0]["profile"]["skills"].append("first-only")
        result[0]["profile"]["address"]["city"] = "Elsewhere"
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["profile"]["skills"], ["python"])
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["profile"]["address"]["city"], "Bengaluru")
        self.assertEqual(visible, ["u1", "u2"])

    def test_empty_inputs_and_no_matches(self):
        self.assertEqual(select_visible_profiles([], []), [])
        self.assertEqual(
            select_visible_profiles([{"id": "x", "display_name": "X", "profile": {}}], set()),
            [],
        )

    def test_malformed_arguments(self):
        valid = {"id": "x", "display_name": "X", "profile": {}}
        cases = [
            (None, []),
            ([], "x"),
            ([None], []),
            ([{"id": "", "display_name": "X", "profile": {}}], []),
            ([{"id": "x", "display_name": 1, "profile": {}}], []),
            ([{"id": "x", "display_name": "X", "profile": []}], []),
            ([valid, dict(valid)], []),
            ([valid], [""]),
            ([valid], ["x", "x"]),
            ([valid], [1]),
        ]
        for followers, visible in cases:
            with self.subTest(followers=followers, visible=visible):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    select_visible_profiles(followers, visible)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
